documents.meaning_for_site: Build dependencies and chosen backend are part of the deployment contract; a package name alone does not prove accelerator support. Current SDK documents Ascend Direct/UBSHMEM separately from CUDA, XPU, MLU and other transports.
documents.specific_exclusion: Do not add all vendor compiler instructions, Store-RS/EP, XPU IPC or HiCache hugepage sizing into the three Ascend conceptual pages. They are different hardware, optional components or SGLang examples and have no verified consumer in the selected four vLLM connector paths. A short link with the pinned version and hardware boundary is appropriate. No build or hardware command was executed.

documents.meaning_for_site: Master is the metadata/control allocator, not the data carrier; resource-owning clients hold segments. An embedded requester, dummy-real forwarding pair, and separate storage service are distinct SDK arrangements. The zero global segment pure-client case supports the two-mode explanation without conflating DummyClient.
additional_boundaries: Store object read lease (default 10 seconds) is separate from NIXL request lease (default 30 seconds).
Object grouping is a best-effort lifecycle hint, not a transaction proving all shards visible or atomically created.
Soft pin is eviction priority with a fixed deadline; hard pin differs. Neither means durable model identity.
DISK, LOCAL_DISK and descriptor DFS have distinct ownership and recovery rules; experimental DFS is outside generic fault-tolerance guarantees.

Introductory immutable-value wording must be read with the later explicit Upsert lifecycle; introductory availability claim must be read with single-master and HA serving gates. No blanket guarantee is copied into site.
documents.specific_exclusion: Allocation strategy benchmarks, HA snapshot internal protocols, grouping, CXL/HCA locality and API protobuf catalogue have been read, but are not presented as capabilities already used by AscendStore or the fixed vLLM integrations. The existing site does not need every SDK feature duplicated.

documents.meaning_for_site: Master, TE metadata, resource-owning clients and requester processes are different roles and ports. SSD owner fields and three launch methods require separate configuration spelling. Eager offload differs from eviction-triggered offload; legacy shared-filesystem persistence cannot be silently mixed into local SSD.
additional_boundaries: The generic Method B statement about vLLM/SGLang reading MooncakeConfig is not applied to the selected fixed vLLM sources: their own MooncakeStoreConfig loads mandatory JSON and then calls setup.
A Store service can supply TE metadata through the embedded HTTP service, or use P2PHANDSHAKE; a separate external metadata daemon is not universally required.
HA election alone is not metadata continuity; etcd OpLog/snapshot serving gates and Redis experimental constraints matter. None is claimed enabled by simply starting mooncake_master.
A successful DFS WriteAt is not fsync durability; DFS allocator recovery and multi-tenant support are explicitly incomplete.
Local hot-cache bytes, shared memory, HugeTLB and SPDK registration are separate options; no inference that enabling one makes the old Ascend consumer use the others.
documents.specific_exclusion: HA maintenance, etcd compaction/destructive reset, experimental DFS/NoF, object-event publishers and every MC_* performance knob are outside the present three-page teaching scope. They remain read-and-classified reference branches, not executable instructions or claims of installed support.
